title: Ensuite renovation in Merrow, Guildford
summary: A complete ensuite refurbishment carried out by Nigel Harvey Plumbing, from strip-out and wall reconstruction to the shower, WC, vanity, heated towel rail, tiling and flooring.
problem: The ensuite needed a complete refurbishment. During strip-out, Nigel opened up the internal walls and found problems with the existing wall and insulation build-up, including visible mould in affected areas.
findings: He stripped back the affected construction rather than covering it over, then rebuilt the wall build-up ready for waterproof boarding, tiling and the final fit-out.
work: Strip out the existing ensuite and open up the affected wall construction.
Strip back the affected construction and rebuild the internal wall build-up.
Fit Marmox waterproof building boards and seal and waterproof joints and vulnerable areas.
Carry out the plumbing and install the shower tray and shower fittings.
Fit the WC, basin and vanity, and radiator / heated towel rail.
Complete the wall tiling, flooring and final fit-out.
materials: Sealing and waterproofing at joints and vulnerable areas
result: The completed ensuite brings together a fitted shower and tray with a glass enclosure, WC, basin and vanity, and heated towel rail. Grey wall tiles, a green tiled feature above the vanity and herringbone-pattern flooring are visible in the finished photographs. Nigel carried out the complete job, including the preparation behind the finished surfaces.

review.text: Nigel did a complete fit of an en-suite bathroom for us, including radiation, tiling, flooring, shower tray, glass window and toilet. We are very pleased with the result. Nigel communicated well and explained options along the way. Much recommended.

faqs.question: Was the affected wall simply tiled over?
faqs.answer: No. Nigel stripped back the affected construction, rebuilt the wall build-up, then fitted Marmox waterproof building boards and sealed and waterproofed joints and vulnerable areas before tiling.

faqs.question: Did Nigel carry out the whole ensuite refurbishment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Nigel carried out the strip-out, wall reconstruction, plumbing, shower and sanitaryware installation, radiator / heated towel rail, wall tiling, flooring and final fit-out.
